cues.en: Hello. I wish to register a complete.
cues.zh: 你好，我想登记一个完整的。

cues.en: Oh, I'm sorry. I have a cold. I wish to make a complaint.
cues.zh: 哦，抱歉。我感冒了。我想投诉。

cues.en: Oh, sorry. We're closing for lunch. Never mind that, my lad. I wish to complain about this pallet, what I purchased not half an hour ago from this very boutique. Oh, yes. The Norwegian blue. What's wrong with it? I'll tell you what's wrong with it, my lad. It's dead. That's what's wrong with it.
cues.zh: 哦，抱歉。我们要关门吃午饭了。别管那个，小伙子。我想投诉这个托盘，不到半小时前我刚从这家精品店买的。哦，是的。挪威蓝。它有什么问题？我告诉你它有什么问题，小伙子。它死了。这就是问题所在。

cues.en: Now now I see. It's resting. Look.
cues.zh: 现在我明白了。它在休息。瞧。

cues.en: Don't my lad. I know a dead parrot when I see one, and I'm looking at one right now. No. That's not dead. It's resting.
cues.zh: 别这样，年轻人。我一眼就能看出鹦鹉死没死，而我现在看到的就是一只死鹦鹉。不，它没死。它在休息。

cues.en: Yeah. Resting. Remarkable bird of Norwegian blow, ain't it? Beautiful plumage.
cues.zh: 没错，在休息。这挪威鹦鹉真不一般，对吧？羽毛真漂亮。

cues.en: The plumage don't enter into it. It's stone dead.
cues.zh: 羽毛漂不漂亮跟这没关系。它已经死透了。

cues.en: Alright then. If it's resting, I'll wake it up.
cues.zh: 好吧。既然它在休息，那我就把它叫醒。

cues.en: I've got a nice fresh cuttlefish for you if you wake up, mister Polly Power. There he moved. No. He didn't. That was you pushing the cage. I didn't. Yes. You did.
cues.zh: 你要是醒过来，我就给你一条新鲜的墨鱼，波莉·鲍尔先生。它动了。没有，它没动。是你推了笼子。我没有。你推了。
这是你的九点闹钟服务。

cues.en: Now that's what I call a dead parrot.
cues.zh: 这才叫名副其实的死鹦鹉。

cues.en: Yeah. You stunned him just as he was waking up. Norwegian Blue stunned easily. My lord, I've had enough of this. That parrot is definitely deceased.
cues.zh: 对啊。它刚要醒你就把它弄晕了。挪威蓝鹦鹉很容易晕的。老天啊，我受够了。这只鹦鹉绝对已经死了。

cues.en: And when I bought it not half an hour ago, you assured me that its total lack of movement was due to it being tired and shagged out after a long squawk.
cues.zh: 我不到半小时前买它的时候，你还跟我保证它一动不动只是因为叫得太久、累得精疲力尽了。

cues.en: What kind of talk is that? Look why did it fall flat in its back the moment I got it home? Oh what the norwegian blue prefers keeping on its back. Beautiful plumage. Look, I taught the liberty of examining that parrot.
cues.zh: 这叫什么话？瞧，我一到家它怎么就仰面倒下了？哦，挪威蓝鹦鹉就喜欢仰面躺着。漂亮的羽毛。看，我冒昧检查了那只鹦鹉。

cues.en: And I discovered that the only reason that it had been sitting on its perch in the first place was that it had been nailed there.
cues.zh: 结果我发现，它一开始之所以待在栖木上，唯一的原因就是它被钉在了那里。

cues.en: Oh, and of course it was nailed there. I mean, if I hadn't nailed it there, it would have muscle up those bars and boom.
cues.zh: 哦，它当然是被钉在那里的。我是说，如果我没把它钉在那儿，它早就使劲撞开那些栏杆，砰的一下飞走了。

cues.en: This part wouldn't voom if you put 4,000 volts through it.
cues.zh: 这玩意儿就算通上四千伏电压，也转不起来。

cues.en: and gone to see its maker. This
bereft of life. It rests in peace. If you hadn't nailed it to the perch, it would be pushing up the daisies.
cues.zh: 毫无生气，安息了。要不是你把它钉在栖木上，它早就化作春泥了。

cues.en: It's rung down the curtain and joined the choir invisible.
cues.zh: 它已经落下帷幕，加入了无形的唱诗班。

cues.en: Well, I better replace it then.
cues.zh: 好吧，那我最好给您换一只。

cues.en: If you wanna get anything done in this country, you gotta complain to go blue in the nose.
cues.zh: 在这个国家想办成点事，就得抱怨到脸红脖子粗才行。

cues.en: Sorry, squire. I've had a look. We're right out of parrots. I see. I get the picture.
cues.zh: 抱歉了，先生。我看过了，鹦鹉正好全卖光了。明白了，我懂了。

cues.en: Well, it's scarcely a replacement then, is it?
cues.zh: 那它根本算不上是替代品，对吧？

cues.en: I didn't want to work in a pet shop.
cues.zh: 我本来就不想在宠物店工作的。

cues.en: I wanted to be a lumberjack.
I'm sorry. This is irrelevant, isn't it? Yes.
leaping from tree to tree as they float down the mighty rivers of British Columbia.
cues.zh: 在英属哥伦比亚的壮阔河流上，从一棵树跳到另一棵树。
